title: Construction Contracts for Generated Embedded Domain-Specific Language Programs: A Measurement Protocol and a Conditional Effect
abstract: arXiv:2611.06525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A generated domain-specific program can be accepted by its host and still miss the reference construction. We measure the two events separately and test a short construction contract. The vehicle is Open Quantum Assembly Language (OpenQASM) 3. One 3-billion-parameter generator is run under seven conditions on 100 quantum approximate optimization (QAOA) and 100 variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) instances. Eighty of 100 QAOA signatures appear in some training split. Exact McNemar tests and 95% paired bootstrap intervals are used. The contract, a card, lists structural decisions, enters the prompt, and is checked without a simulator. Parse rates are 0.55 to 0.97 and full structural match is 0.02 to 0.87. On QAOA, at fixed weights, the card moves full match by +32.0 percentage points on card-trained weights (interval +22 to +42) and by -13.0 (-23 to -3) without that training. translated_title: 嵌入式领域特定语言生成程序的构建契约：一种测量协议与一个条件效应
translated_abstract: 一个被生成的领域特定程序即使被其宿主接受，仍可能未能匹配参考构建。我们将这两个事件分开测量，并测试一种简短的构建契约。研究载体为开放量子汇编语言（OpenQASM）3。一个30亿参数的生成器在七种条件下分别运行于100个量子近似优化算法（QAOA）实例和100个变分量子本征求解器（VQE）实例。100个QAOA签名中有80个出现在某些训练分割中。研究采用精确McNemar检验和95%配对自助法置信区间。该契约是一张卡片，列出结构性决策、进入提示词中，并且无需模拟器即可检查。解析率为0.55至0.97，完全结构匹配率为0.02至0.87。在QAOA上，在固定权重下，该卡片在经过卡片训练的权重上使完全匹配率提高32.0个百分点（区间+22至+42），而在没有该训练时则降低13.0个百分点（-23至-3）。这+45.0个百分点的差异并非部署对比。
tldr: 该论文提出区分“程序可解析”与“匹配参考构建”这两种不同事件的测量协议，并发现一种简短的“构建契约卡片”对OpenQASM 3量子程序生成的效果具有条件性：生成器经过卡片训练时完全匹配率提升32个百分点，未经训练时反而下降13个百分点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a measurement protocol that separates parse acceptance from full structural match for generated DSL programs, and reveals a conditional effect: a short construction-contract card improves OpenQASM 3 program matching by +32 percentage points only when the generator was trained with the card, but degrades it by 13 points otherwise.
